Of the 1049 linked objects, only three come from GPL-tagged sources (the Pong-family netlists nl_breakout/nl_pongdoubles/nl_rebound), all tagged GPL-2.0+; the drivers, framework and every compiled dependency are BSD-3-Clause or otherwise permissive, and no GPL-2.0-only tag exists anywhere in the tree. Remaining risk is TRADEMARK, not copyright: MAME is a registered trademark of Gregory Ember and that file states permission is required to use the name, logo, or wordmark. Lucent uses the bare name as displayName and in liblucent_core_mame.so; resolve before shipping.
